spotlight.title: You track how you feel — and ask why
spotlight.takeaway: You may be developing a recovery-awareness loop. Noticing the sleep-energy connection is the first step toward using it deliberately.
spotlight.evidence_trail: March 8 journal: 'Wonder if the long sleep helped? Felt very very refreshed this morning.' This is the first time in 13 journal entries across the past three weeks that you explicitly connected a physical input (sleep) to a mood output and posed it as a question worth investigating. Every other entry names a feeling but doesn't probe its cause. This one does — and it landed on your highest-output day of the entire honeymoon.

research_context.body: Curiosity about internal states — called interoceptive awareness — predicts better self-regulation over time. Researchers Farb & Segal (2012) found that people who ask 'why do I feel this way?' rather than just labeling emotions show stronger habit formation and stress resilience.
